description: Render Markdown to HTML, build a TOC and compute statistics. Operations: "render" — Render GitHub-flavored Markdown to sanitized HTML.; "toc" — Extract a table of contents from Markdown headers.; "stats" — Compute document statistics for Markdown/plain text.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: render: The Markdown to render. toc: The Markdown to scan. stats: The text to analyze.

operation.description: render — Render GitHub-flavored Markdown to sanitized HTML. toc — Extract a table of contents from Markdown headers. stats — Compute document statistics for Markdown/plain text.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: markdown
title: Markdown Preview
